title: Baseball History in Data
text:
Welcome to our project! This site explores the rich history of Major League Baseball through its data, using the comprehensive Lahman Baseball Database.
Our analysis focuses on home run trends across two key perspectives:

Home runs: Investigates league-wide home run trends over time. We show how raw home run totals can create misleading “collapses” during shortened seasons (such as 1981, 1994, and 2020), and how calculating home runs per game reveals the true historical progression of power hitting.
Sluggers: Examines the top 15 all-time career home run leaders, highlighting players who were active during the 1994–2009 “steroid era” and zooming in on the season-by-season trajectory of all-time leader Barry Bonds.

Use the navigation bar at the top of the page to explore each section!
